explanation: This fires only at D1, when the previous trial was unrewarded but the trial before that was rewarded (the first loss after a win). It is strongest (8-10) while the agent is on a run of a1 choices in roughly trials 55-85 of the episode, weaker (about 3) around trial 45-50, and 0 earlier, at a second loss in a row, after a2 choices, and at every GO and D2 step.
